item.title: AI job exposure highest among older, highly paid and educated workers, Anthropic report finds
item.description: The findings challenge a common narrative that automation primarily threatens lower-skilled or lower-income jobs, suggesting instead that generative AI tools may disproportionately affect white-collar roles.
